_comment: Generated by tool/generate_rule_catalog.dart from the rule classes; do not edit.

avoid_bang.message: avoid the null-assertion operator `!` — it bypasses null safety and can crash at runtime.
avoid_bang.correction: Use an explicit null check (if (x != null)) or a null-aware pattern.

extend_base_cubit.description: Cubits must extend BaseCubit, not Cubit directly.
extend_base_cubit.message: cubits must extend BaseCubit, not Cubit directly.

no_widget_builder_method.description: Do not use private helper methods that return a Widget; extract a Widget subclass instead.
no_widget_builder_method.message: do not build widgets in private helper methods; extract a Widget subclass instead.
no_widget_builder_method.correction: Replace this `Widget _build...()` helper with a dedicated Widget class.

no_raw_color.description: Do not use raw colors; resolve them through the theme.
no_raw_color.message: do not use raw colors; resolve them through the theme (context.appColors / context.defaultColors).
no_raw_color.correction: Replace this raw color with a theme token from AppColors.

no_raw_asset_path.description: Do not hardcode asset path strings; use AppAssets tokens.
no_raw_asset_path.message: do not hardcode 'assets/...' path strings; use AppAssets tokens.
no_raw_asset_path.correction: Reference this asset via a constant in AppAssets.

no_tr_in_global_widget.description: Global widgets must not call tr(); callers pass translated text.
no_tr_in_global_widget.message: global widgets must not call tr(); callers pass already-translated text as parameters.
no_tr_in_global_widget.correction: Remove the tr() call and accept the text via a constructor parameter.

use_kit_widgets.description: Use the admin widget kit instead of raw Flutter widgets.
use_kit_widgets.message: {0} is raw Flutter that the widget kit replaces; use {1}.

no_navigator.description: Navigate with go_router, never with Navigator.

use_context_getters.description: Reach cubits through the typed context getters of the flavour.
use_context_getters.message: {0} reads a provider directly; use the typed getter (context.xCubit) from the providers file ({1}).
use_context_getters.correction: Add the getter to the providers file if it is missing, then call it here.

cubit_created_in_provider.description: Construct blocs and cubits only in a provider create callback.
cubit_created_in_provider.message: {0} is constructed outside a provider; create it in BlocProvider(create: (_) => {0}(...)..load()) in the route, or Utils.showCustomModalBottomSheet(create:).
cubit_created_in_provider.correction: Move the construction into the create: callback that provides it.

provider_in_router.description: Provide cubits only in the router, the shell and the dialog helper.
provider_in_router.message: {0} outside the router; provide page cubits in the route builder ({1}) and dialog cubits with Utils.showCustomModalBottomSheet(create:).
provider_in_router.correction: Move the provider into the route builder or the dialog helper call.

no_cubit_call_in_lifecycle.description: Do not call cubit methods in widget lifecycle methods.
no_cubit_call_in_lifecycle.message: {0}() is called in {1}; load in the provider instead: BlocProvider(create: (_) => XCubit(...)..load()).
no_cubit_call_in_lifecycle.correction: Move the call into the create: callback, or into a user-action callback.

no_provider_value.description: Do not provide a cubit held in a State with BlocProvider.value.
no_provider_value.message: BlocProvider.value provides `{0}`, a cubit held in this State; create it with BlocProvider(create: ...) in the route or Utils.showCustomModalBottomSheet(create:).
no_provider_value.correction: Remove the field and let a provider create and close the cubit.

cancel_subscriptions_in_close.description: Store stream subscriptions of a cubit in a field and cancel them in close().
cancel_subscriptions_in_close.message: {0}; store the subscription in a field and cancel it in close(): `await _sub?.cancel(); return super.close();`.
cancel_subscriptions_in_close.correction: Assign the listen() result to a StreamSubscription field and cancel it in close().

alert_only_in_cubit.description: Show alerts from cubits, never from UI code.
alert_only_in_cubit.message: AlertCubit in UI code; inject AlertCubit into the cubit and call showSuccess / showError in the cubit method that knows the outcome.
alert_only_in_cubit.correction: Remove the AlertCubit reference from this widget.

state_is_sealed.description: Page cubit states are sealed class hierarchies.
state_is_sealed.message: the state `{0}` of this cubit is not a sealed class; declare `sealed class {0}` holding the data every state shows, with final Initial / Loading / Loaded / Error subclasses (Loading and Error keep the last data, busy markers only on Loaded).
state_is_sealed.correction: Make the state a sealed class hierarchy, or move an app-wide cubit to lib/bloc/<app>/app_wide/.

no_status_enum_state.description: States use sealed subclasses, not a status enum field.
no_status_enum_state.message: state field `{0}` is a status enum ({1}); make each status a subclass of a sealed state (XLoading, XLoaded(data), XError(message)).
no_status_enum_state.correction: Replace the enum field with sealed state subclasses.

no_state_enum_branching.description: The UI switches on the state type, never on an enum field of a cubit state.
no_state_enum_branching.message: the UI branches on `{0}.{1}`, an enum field of a cubit state; make each value a subclass of the sealed state and switch on the state itself.
no_state_enum_branching.correction: Replace the enum field with sealed state subclasses (one per value the UI shows).

dialog_only_in_listener.description: Open dialogs only from a presentation listener.
dialog_only_in_listener.message: a dialog is opened outside a presentation listener; call a cubit method that emits an event, and open the dialog in BlocPresentationListener(listener:) or a show* function it calls.
dialog_only_in_listener.correction: Emit a presentation event from the cubit and map it to this dialog in the listener.

no_dialog_result.description: Never use the result of a dialog.
no_dialog_result.message: {0} uses the result of {1}; a dialog returns nothing. Its buttons call the cubit (its own cubit, or a cubit-method callback carried by the presentation event).
no_dialog_result.correction: Move the follow-up into the cubit method the dialog button calls.

listener_is_mapping.description: Presentation listeners only map events to dialogs or navigation.
listener_is_mapping.message: the presentation listener {0}; it may only map `event is X` to one show call. Put what the dialog needs into the event in the cubit.
listener_is_mapping.correction: Move this logic into the cubit that emits the event.

no_navigation_in_ui.description: Navigate through presentation events, not from UI code.
no_navigation_in_ui.message: context.{0} in UI code; call a cubit method that emits NavigateTo (or CloseDialog) and let PresentationEventHandler navigate.
no_navigation_in_ui.correction: Emit a presentation event from the cubit instead.

ui_callback_calls_cubit.description: Page callbacks only call one cubit method or forward a callback.
ui_callback_calls_cubit.message: `{0}:` {1}; a page callback is a cubit-method tear-off (cubit.save), one cubit-method call, or a forwarded callback parameter. Move the logic into the cubit.
ui_callback_calls_cubit.correction: Add a cubit method that does this and call it here.

no_setstate_in_pages.description: Pages keep no local state; the cubit does.
no_setstate_in_pages.message: setState in a page; keep selection, filters and search in the cubit and render its state with BlocBuilder.
no_setstate_in_pages.correction: Add a cubit method that emits the new state and call it here.

no_private_methods_in_page_state.description: A page or feature State has only lifecycle methods and build.
no_private_methods_in_page_state.message: `{0}` in a page or feature State; a page or feature State has only lifecycle methods and build. Logic goes into the cubit, pieces of UI into widget classes.
no_private_methods_in_page_state.correction: Move the logic into a cubit method, or the UI into its own widget.

stateful_page_only_for_controllers.description: StatefulWidget in pages and features only to own controllers.
stateful_page_only_for_controllers.message: page or feature State `{0}` {1}; a StatefulWidget in a page or feature only owns controllers (TextEditingController, FocusNode, ...). Keep everything else in the cubit, or use a StatelessWidget.
stateful_page_only_for_controllers.correction: Move the field into the cubit state, or make the widget stateless.

no_editor_controller_in_pages.message: {0} in a page; the editor validates itself and calls onSubmit(data) with valid data. Pass onSubmit: cubit.save.
no_editor_controller_in_pages.correction: Remove the controller and validate() from the page.

page_uses_template.description: Pages are composed from a Template widget.
page_uses_template.message: the page builds `{0}`, not a template; return a {@category Template} widget (AppContentPage, AdminLayout, AppEditorScaffold) through BlocProvider / BlocBuilder / BlocPresentationListener.
page_uses_template.correction: Wrap the page content in a template widget.

page_has_title_subtitle.description: AppContentPage gets both a title and a subtitle.
page_has_title_subtitle.message: AppContentPage without {0}; every content page passes title: and subtitle: (tr keys <app>_<page>_title / _subtitle).
page_has_title_subtitle.correction: Add the missing argument and its translation keys.

global_widgets_layering.description: Global widgets never import pages or features.
global_widgets_layering.message: a global widget imports {0}; global_widgets/ must not depend on pages/ or features/. Pass texts and callbacks in as parameters.
global_widgets_layering.correction: Remove the import and take the value as a parameter.

component_has_no_state_access.description: Components, layouts and patterns do not read app state.
component_has_no_state_access.message: {0} in a {1} widget; components, layouts and patterns draw from parameters and the theme only. Read state in the page (or make it a Feature).
component_has_no_state_access.correction: Pass the data in as parameters.

no_repository_in_ui.description: UI code reads data through cubits, never repositories.
no_repository_in_ui.message: `{0}` in UI code; pages and widgets get data from their cubit. Inject the repository into the cubit.
no_repository_in_ui.correction: Move the repository call into a cubit method.

no_http_in_ui.description: HTTP clients only in the API layer.
no_http_in_ui.message: UI code imports `{0}`; HTTP belongs to the API layer (request models, repositories, services). Call it from a cubit.
no_http_in_ui.correction: Move the request into the API layer and call it from the cubit.

global_widget_has_category.description: Kit widgets name their tier with {@category}.
global_widget_has_category.message: `{0}` has no valid tier; end its doc comment with `/// {@category X}` (Component, Layout, Behavior, Pattern, Template, Feature, Skeleton).

kit_src_internal.description: Kit internals under src/ stay inside the kit.
kit_src_internal.message: `{0}` is an internal part of a kit; import the kit's public widget instead.
kit_src_internal.correction: Import the public library next to the src/ folder.

no_role_literal.description: Use the role enums, never role strings.
no_role_literal.message: role string '{0}'; use the role enums (AppRole, NeoncodeRole, VernakRole in lib/model/enums/).
no_role_literal.correction: Replace the string with the enum value (e.g. AppRole.vernakAdmin).

no_access_guard_in_pages.description: Access is declared on the route, not inside the page.
no_access_guard_in_pages.message: {0} inside a page; declare the permission on the route ((rules) => rules.canX, evaluated against the active company role).
no_access_guard_in_pages.correction: Move the guard to the route builder.

no_media_query_size.description: Read the screen size only through app_responsive.dart.
no_media_query_size.message: `{0}` reads the screen size; use context.screenSize / ResponsiveBuilder / context.responsiveValue (lib/utils/ui/app_responsive.dart).
no_media_query_size.correction: Decide by AppScreenSize, not by pixels.

no_kisweb_in_ui.description: UI does not branch on kIsWeb.
no_kisweb_in_ui.message: kIsWeb in UI code; decide the layout by screen size with context.screenSize / ResponsiveBuilder / context.responsiveValue (lib/utils/ui/app_responsive.dart).
no_kisweb_in_ui.correction: A narrow browser window gets the phone layout, a tablet app the wide one.

no_platform_in_ui.description: UI does not branch on the platform.
no_platform_in_ui.message: `{0}` in UI code; the layout follows the screen size (context.screenSize / ResponsiveBuilder / context.responsiveValue (lib/utils/ui/app_responsive.dart)). Platform differences belong to the flavour or a service.
no_platform_in_ui.correction: Move the platform decision out of the widget.

no_layout_builder_in_pages.message: LayoutBuilder outside lib/global_widgets; pages use ResponsiveBuilder / context.screenSize, or a kit widget that adapts to its constraints (TwoPanelLayout, AppStatGrid.responsive).
no_layout_builder_in_pages.correction: Use ResponsiveBuilder, or move the adaptive piece into a global widget.

no_raw_breakpoint.description: No width compared with a numeric literal.
no_raw_breakpoint.message: `{0}` is a hand-made breakpoint; use AppScreenSize (context.screenSize / ResponsiveBuilder / context.responsiveValue (lib/utils/ui/app_responsive.dart)).

no_raw_dimension.description: Dimensions come from the scale or the widget dimens.
no_raw_dimension.message: raw dimension `{0}`; use the scale (AppSpacing, AppRadius, AppIconSize, ... in lib/utils/ui/tokens/) or the widget's own <Widget>Dimens.
no_raw_dimension.correction: Add the value to the widget dimens file (or use a scale step) and reference it.

dimens_private_to_widget.description: A widget dimens class belongs to its own folder.
dimens_private_to_widget.message: `{0}` belongs to another widget; use your own <Widget>Dimens or the scale (lib/utils/ui/tokens/).
dimens_private_to_widget.correction: Give this widget its own dimens, built from the scale.

scale_only_in_dimens.description: The scale is read only by *_dimens.dart files.
scale_only_in_dimens.message: `{0}` reads the scale outside a dimens file; give the value a role name in this piece's own <Name>Dimens (built from the scale) and use that.
scale_only_in_dimens.correction: Add `static const <role> = {0};` to the piece's <name>_dimens.dart and reference it.

no_app_dimens.message: `{0}` uses the old AppDimens; use the scale (AppSpacing, AppRadius, ... in lib/utils/ui/tokens/) or the widget's own <Widget>Dimens.
no_app_dimens.correction: Take the value from the scale or the widget dimens.

component_takes_variant.description: Components take a variant, not raw dimensions.
component_takes_variant.message: component parameter `{0}` is a raw dimension; offer named variants in <Widget>Dimens and take `variant:`.
component_takes_variant.correction: Replace the parameter with a variant of the widget dimens.

piece_in_own_folder.description: Every piece lives in its own folder, named after its file.
piece_in_own_folder.message: `{0}` is not in its own folder; move it to `{1}` (beside its dimens and skeleton). A part of a bigger piece goes into a subfolder of that piece's folder.
piece_in_own_folder.correction: Move the widget into its folder and keep one public entry file there.

piece_has_skeleton.description: Every piece with a look of its own has a skeleton in its folder.
piece_has_skeleton.message: `{0}` has no skeleton; add `{1}` declaring `{0}Skeleton`, built from the skeleton primitives and the same <Name>Dimens as the widget.
piece_has_skeleton.correction: Write the skeleton beside the widget; a page skeleton is composed from its pieces' skeletons.

no_raw_text_style.message: {0}; every weight / size combination is a named style in AppTextStyles (context.appText.x). Only copyWith(color: ...) is allowed here.
no_raw_text_style.correction: Add a named style to app_text_styles.dart and use it.

no_debug_print.description: Log through the app logger, not debugPrint.
no_debug_print.message: debugPrint; log through the app logger (lib/utils/helpers/log_utils.dart).
no_debug_print.correction: Replace it with the logger, or remove the leftover.

no_hardcoded_ui_string.message: hardcoded text '{0}'; use tr('key') with the key in every language file (a global widget takes the text as a String parameter).
no_hardcoded_ui_string.correction: Add a translation key to cs / en / sk and use tr().

no_dash_in_strings.message: the string contains `{0}`; use a comma, a full stop, "od X do Y" or the common_date_range key.
no_dash_in_strings.correction: Rewrite the text without the dash.

result_handles_unauthorized.description: Result.when(...) without unauthorized: swallows a 401; use handleError.
result_handles_unauthorized.message: Result.when(...) without `unauthorized:` runs no branch on a 401, so the caller hangs in its loading state; use result.handleError(error: ..., success: ...).
result_handles_unauthorized.correction: Replace with handleError(error:, success:), which routes Unauthorized to error, or pass an explicit unauthorized: callback.

use_shared_utils.description: Use the neon_flutter_utils helpers instead of the raw APIs they wrap.
use_shared_utils.message: {0} is a raw API that neon_flutter_utils wraps; use {1}.

category_matches_folder.description: A widget's folder says its layer: its {@category} matches the layer folder it sits in.
category_matches_folder.message: the folder of `{0}` does not say its layer: {1}.
category_matches_folder.correction: Put the widget in the folder of its layer: Component components/, Layout layouts/, Behavior behaviors/, Pattern patterns/, Template templates/, Skeleton skeletons/, Feature features/, any *Dialog or *Sheet dialogs/; under lib/global_widgets/<owner>/ and in widgets/ of a page or feature.

labels_only_in_kit.description: Only the widget kit takes *Labels objects; features and pages call tr() where they draw.
labels_only_in_kit.message: {0}; features and pages call tr() where they draw; per-flavour wording comes from FlavorConfig.
labels_only_in_kit.correction: Call tr('key') where the text is drawn and drop the *Labels class or parameter; when the wording differs per administration, pick the key from FlavorConfig.

feature_reads_state.description: A Feature reads state; a widget that reads none belongs to the kit or to its one page.
feature_reads_state.message: the Feature `{0}` reads no state (no context getter, cubit or repository); it belongs to the kit (lib/global_widgets/), or into the one page that uses it.
feature_reads_state.correction: Move it to the kit with its texts and data as parameters (category Component, Pattern, ...), or into <page>/widgets/ when only one page uses it.

no_data_logic_in_ui.description: UI only draws; computations over data happen in the cubit, which emits ready-to-draw data.
no_data_logic_in_ui.message: {0} in a widget; UI only draws. The cubit is the controller: it computes over the data and emits ready-to-draw values (filtered or sorted IDs, formatted numbers and dates, flags).
no_data_logic_in_ui.correction: Move the computation into the cubit and put its result into the state; pure stateless logic goes to neon_flutter_utils or lib/utils/helpers/.

dialog_opener_returns_void.description: A dialog opener (show* function) returns void.
dialog_opener_returns_void.message: the dialog opener {0} returns {1}; a dialog returns nothing, so an opener returns void and the listener calls it without unawaited().
dialog_opener_returns_void.correction: Declare it `void {0}(...)` and open the dialog with Utils.openModalBottomSheet(...); the listener line becomes `if (event is X) return {0}(context, event);`.

no_unawaited_dialog_opener.description: Call a dialog opener directly; it returns void.
no_unawaited_dialog_opener.correction: Make the opener `void` (it calls Utils.openModalBottomSheet) and write the listener line as `if (event is X) return showX(context, event);`.

cubit_only_state.description: Manage state with a Cubit extending BaseCubit and a sealed state, nothing else.
cubit_only_state.message: {0} is not how this app manages state; use {1}.

no_value_notifier_state.description: No ValueNotifier as app state outside the widget kit; the cubit state holds the value.
no_value_notifier_state.message: {0} is app state outside the cubits; use {1}.

enum_in_enums_folder.description: Every enum lives in lib/model/enums/<scope>/<name>.dart, one enum per file.
enum_in_enums_folder.correction: Declare every enum in its own file lib/model/enums/<scope>/<name>.dart, <scope> being common/ or the project (vernak/, neoncode/, ...); only the kit variant enums of lib/global_widgets/**/*_dimens.dart stay beside their widget.

one_declaration_per_model_file.description: One top-level class, enum or extension per model file.
one_declaration_per_model_file.message: {0} is a further top-level declaration of this model file; move it into its own file {1}.dart.
one_declaration_per_model_file.correction: Declare one class, enum or extension per model file, the file named after it (an enum in lib/model/enums/<scope>/); fold an extension into the class or enum it extends.

models_only_in_model.description: Models live only in lib/model/, and lib/model/ holds nothing but models.
models_only_in_model.message: {0}; models live only in the model role ({1}) and it holds nothing but models.
models_only_in_model.correction: Move a serializing class into lib/model/ (one declaration per file); move widgets, dimens and other UI out of lib/model/ to the piece that draws it; take Color from dart:ui.

no_logic_in_models.description: No top-level helper functions in model files.
no_logic_in_models.message: top-level function {0} in a model file; models hold data, no helper functions.
no_logic_in_models.correction: Parse through json_serializable (@JsonKey, the converters of package:neon_flutter_utils/json.dart), make a derived value a getter or named constructor of the model, or move the helper to lib/utils/ or into the cubit.

model_uses_json_serializable.description: Models serialize through json_serializable: @JsonSerializable and the generated functions.
model_uses_json_serializable.correction: Annotate the model @JsonSerializable(), add `part '<file>.g.dart';`, make fromJson return _$XFromJson(json) and toJson return _$XToJson(this), and express special cases with @JsonKey(fromJson:, toJson:, defaultValue:, unknownEnumValue:), @JsonEnum and the converters of package:neon_flutter_utils/json.dart; then run build_runner.

no_dynamic_in_models.description: No dynamic, Object? or Map<String, dynamic> fields, parameters or getters in models.
no_dynamic_in_models.message: {0} of {1} is '{2}'; a model field, constructor parameter or getter has a concrete type.
no_dynamic_in_models.correction: Give it a typed model or a concrete type (a nested @JsonSerializable class, an enum, List<X>, Map<String, X>); keep Map<String, dynamic> only as the fromJson parameter and the toJson result.

request_extends_project_base.description: A request in request_models/<project>/ extends that project's base; only the bases set project.
request_extends_project_base.correction: Put the request in lib/model/request_models/<project>/<domain>/<name>_request.dart and extend the base of that project from request_models/_base/ (VernakRequest, NeoncodeRequest, DoorDropRequest, QuestRequest; common/ extends NeoRequest; TenantScopedRequest when the caller chooses the tenant). Only the bases override `project`.

no_tenant_in_extra_headers.description: The tenant is never set in extraHeaders; the request declares project through its base.
no_tenant_in_extra_headers.correction: Remove the x-project header and extend the project base from request_models/_base/ (TenantScopedRequest when the caller chooses the tenant).
